key_insight: BayesPath improves training-free whole-slide pathology reasoning by tracking diagnostic beliefs and discounting unreliable or correlated AI observations.
clinical_relevance: Its interpretable evidence trail and calibrated uncertainty could support pathology review and flag uncertain cases for pathologist assessment.
method: Uses a Scan–Look–Weigh–Decide loop to guide region selection and stopping.
Updates candidate beliefs through reliability-aware Bayesian inference.
Corrects answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and models diagnostic confusions estimated without labels.
evidence_signal: Across five MultiPathQA slide-classification and slide-VQA tasks, BayesPath achieved 58.6% average accuracy versus 34.1% for the next-best training-free agent.
watch_item: Benchmark gains do not establish clinical safety or generalizability; real-world validation is needed before clinical use.
paper_title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
